_comment: Full UI end-to-end (PLAN.md §7) — the first continuous run through the actual cockpit with NOTHING stubbed: email login → user-chosen subname (G1) → operator Ledger mint → in-browser poll auto-detected the mint → /provision streamed live (9 steps) → card re-anchored → a gated NLI action AS alice executed in the ChatKit chat. Proves G1-G5 converge in the real UI.
name: alice.steg.eth
provisionedVia: Cockpit UI: AgentLoginProvision (G1 label input) → useMintWatch poll → POST /provision (hot-key-signed); 1 operator Ledger sig for the mint

tx._note: hotKeyTopUp = 0.0007 ETH from the agent wallet via mm TEE (e2e setup). mint = operator Ledger (setSubnodeRecord, owner=hot key, block 25367315). The provision sub-txs (fund, the G2 5-record rebind, ENSIP-26, agentURI, ENSIP-25, reverse TEE, transfer) ran via /provision (hot key / TEE) and were verified from on-chain state. gatedSelfTransfer = the gated NLI action driven in the actual ChatKit chat (block 25367356, status 1, from==to==server wallet, gas 21000).

ui_e2e.g1_label_input: user typed 'alice' in the in-card form → target alice.steg.eth (was hardcoded demo.steg.eth)
ui_e2e.g1_mint_poll: useMintWatch polled NameWrapper.ownerOf in-browser; auto-detected the operator mint within ~4s and auto-started /provision — no manual UI step
ui_e2e.g3_active_wallet: after provision mm stayed on alice's wallet 0x3993 (verified via mm wallet show)
ui_e2e.reanchor: clicking 'Open alice.steg.eth' re-anchored the cockpit card to alice.steg.eth + 0x3993
ui_e2e.g2_g4_gated_action: in the ChatKit chat as alice: agent previewed a 0-ETH self-transfer → user 'yes' → gate.py derived alice.steg.eth from the active wallet's reverse ENS, TEE-signed, /evaluate → allowed:true → raw_tx_execute broadcast → tx 0x46f832c0 mined. The §0 NLI thesis, live, as a freshly-UI-provisioned agent.

status: COMPLETE — full UI e2e proven; G1-G5 converge in the real cockpit.
note: Fourth demo agent (after demo, demo2, demo3). Minor follow-up: the profile header showed a stale $7.84 balance on re-anchor (cached pre-anchor value; actual alice balance ~$0.49) — the balance read didn't refresh on re-anchor. Cosmetic, non-blocking.
